kanbanMeetingImportPanel.title: Import meeting actions
kanbanMeetingImportPanel.invalidHandoff: There is no transfer, it is more than 10 minutes old, or the data format is invalid. The existing board has not changed. Send the actions again from the meeting minutes tab.
kanbanMeetingImportPanel.copyNotice: Add copies of meeting actions to this board. Existing cards and columns are preserved. Changes are not automatically synced to the original meeting minutes.
kanbanMeetingImportPanel.priorityNotice: Assignees, due dates, and statuses are preserved. Meeting actions have no priority, so new cards start at Medium.
kanbanMeetingImportPanel.duplicateNotice: An action from the same meeting is skipped if it is already on the board. Existing card edits are preserved. Deleted cards can be imported again.
kanbanMeetingImportPanel.newColumnsHint: Append a meeting column only for statuses with new actions. You can edit each column name.
kanbanMeetingImportPanel.existingColumnsHint: Choose the destination for each status. Column meanings are not inferred from their names.
kanbanMeetingImportPanel.allDuplicates: All actions are already on the board. Existing cards are preserved and no empty columns are added.
